original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚高原州疑似绑架者劫走两名视障人士
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高原州Riyom地方政府辖区发生一起绑架事件，两名视障人士在从贝努埃州返回乔斯途中被疑似绑架者劫走。高原州残疾人联合协会主席Shindol Aaron向PUNCH Online证实了这起绑架事件。据报道，绑架者索要5000万奈拉赎金。目前该事件仅有一个来源报道，赎金要求等细节尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Two visually impaired persons have been abducted by suspected kidnappers along the Riyom Local Government Area of Plateau State while returning to Jos from Benue State.

key_facts.fact: 高原州残疾人联合协会主席Shindol Aaron向PUNCH Online证实了这起绑架事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Chairman of the Plateau State chapter of the Joint National Association of Persons with Disabilities, Shindol Aaron, confirmed the abduction in a telephone interview with PUNCH Online in Jos on Tuesday.
